days.title: Northern Wetlands and Filter System
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bellarosa minore
stops.detail: Bellarosa minore is the innermost pond, composed of fresh water, located in the northern area of the pond system and is fed by several streams and refined waters coming from the phytodepuration plant called "Ecosistema Filtro".

stops.name: Ecosistema Filtro
stops.detail: The "Ecosistema Filtro" is a large phytodepuration plant, or rather an artificial wetland, built during recovery works that exploits the self-purifying capacities typical of these environments to refine a portion of the waters coming from the Is Arenas treatment plant and make them suitable for feeding the ponds.

days.title: Coastal Salt Pans and Dunes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Le Saline
stops.detail: The Saline consists of the system of basins included between the strip of Is Arenas and the city of Quartu to the north and the strip of Poetto to the south.

stops.name: Stagno di Quartu
stops.detail: The eastern sector is also known by the name Stagno di Quartu.

stops.name: Poetto
stops.detail: The outermost one, the Poetto, is a more recent back-dune system that separates the Saline and the Quartu pond from the Gulf of the Angels.
